changes_vs_current: Eggs, Cereal, Bacon rise to the top; Pancakes drops from #1 to #6 and Waffles/French Toast to #8-9. Fruit and Toast are added (top 5 in two sources each, not on the current list). Dropped: Grits, Shakshuka. Eggs Benedict, Chicken and Waffles, Croissant and Cinnamon Roll (ranks 21-24) are kept from the current list with no source behind them.
confidence: low-medium. Four sources, but no two share a granularity: Kitchen Infinity and OnePoll are broad categories (Eggs, Cereal), Ranker is dishes, Grubhub is delivery orders (skews to breakfast sandwich, donut, burrito). Ranks 11-20 are mostly penalty artifacts of items missing from short top-5 lists. Missing penalty for Ranker used 37+5=42, since its list reaches at least rank 37. Ranker data is second-hand. Ranks 21-24 are unsourced.
